info.name: Application Performance Monitoring Trace Explorer Query API
Query a trace, span, or service using the Application Performance Monitoring query syntax, and retrieve results (attributes and aggregations) for the queried entity.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM Domain ID for the intended request.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page token representing the page where to start retrieving results.
This is usually retrieved from a previous response.

params.name: timeSpanStartedGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: Include spans that have a `spanStartTime` equal to or greater than this value.

params.name: timeSpanStartedLessThan
params.description: Include spans that have a `spanStartTime`less than this value.

items.docs:
Retrieves the results (selected attributes and aggregations) of a query constructed according to the Application Performance Monitoring Defined Query Syntax.
Query results are filtered by the filter criteria specified in the where clause.
Further query results are grouped by the attributes specified in the group by clause.  Finally,
ordering (asc/desc) is done by the specified attributes in the order by clause.

Returns a list of predefined Quick Pick queries intended to assist the user
to choose a query to run.  There is no sorting applied on the results.
